method.retrieval: Current production lexical_ranking over all independently rebuilt text chunks in each condition
method.scope: All 14 samples for every query; no select_documents, document_refs, file filter, or gold-based query expansion
method.query_rule: Remove only case-insensitive ohr-XXX occurrences from original frozen questions; retain all other characters
method.title_rule: All row titles are empty. Section paths are the unmodified output of build_chunks (empty for the OHR paragraph adapter).
method.noise_rule: Use a fresh in-memory record with gt_text replaced by existing noise_text; no file changes
method.normalization: Production knowledge.normalize: Unicode NFKC, remove whitespace, lowercase. Keep punctuation/markup.
method.document_recall_at_5_chunks: At least one chunk of the expected document appears among the five highest scoring chunks
method.document_recall_at_5_unique_documents: Deduplicate full chunk ranking by first document occurrence; expected document among first five documents
method.expected_document_rank: Rank after first-occurrence document deduplication; null if no positive lexical hit
method.evidence_rule: Every frozen GT excerpt must remain a continuous substring after the same production normalization in both conditions; no markup repair
method.chunk_difference_rule: Compare text by sample_id plus chunk index; extra tail chunks counted separately. This is not an edit distance or semantic alignment.

limitations: Existing 14 extracted pages with manually selected questions/excerpts, not the complete OHR-Bench or official QA benchmark.
This is an offline lexical component test, not end-to-end generation, hybrid/dense retrieval, or answer accuracy.
Provided gt_text and noise_text are evaluated directly. No image rendering or real OCR inference is run.
Strict unchanged-excerpt retention can fail because of formatting even if a reader could reconstruct meaning; it is not a semantic correctness test.
rag-011/ohr-005 originally names the sample. Removing its ID leaves a generic topic question; report that case separately from the 13 content questions.
